infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow MaAI to access camera for non-invasive visual screening and document OCR.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow MaAI to record audio for vernacular maternal symptom check-ins.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow MaAI to select a photo of the eyelid, nail bed, or lab report from your gallery when the camera isn't available.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow MaAI to access camera for visual eyelid/nail bed anemia screening and report OCR.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow MaAI to select a photo of the eyelid, nail bed, or lab report from your gallery when the camera isn't available.
